scenario: Cold-start across engine restart per LCDB.7.3 — cooldown state does not persist; matches refraction. Authors needing cross-restart rate limiting use a logical-fact sentinel. Conformance harness has no restart primitive (a fresh pyds.Engine instance is always at t=0 with empty WM); the compile-side surface a rule with `cooldown 5_min` produces is the same regardless of session boundary, so this pin asserts the compile-ok shape and notes the runtime semantic lives outside the harness.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r cooldown 5_min:
    Trig
->
    log info "x"
